messages.subject_clean: Error running STITCH object 'transMatRate_t' not found
messages.body_plain:
Hi I'm trying to run STITCH on a set oc inbred chickpea genomes. These are MAGIC lines descended from 8 founders.  In order to get ir running I am just analysing a 1Mb segment with about 9K SNPs on 100 BAMs. Once I get it running I'll scale up to 1223 bams across the 600 Mb genome

The options used are:

 outputdir =  /SAN/mottlab/chickpea/Imputation/Results/Ca1_3_Impute_G10
chr= Ca1 regionStart= 2e+06 regionEnd= 3e+06 buffer= 10000
posfile =  /SAN/mottlab/chickpea_raw/STITCH/Ca1.pos.txt
bamlist =  /SAN/mottlab/chickpea_raw/STITCH/bamlist.100.txt
tempdir =  /SAN/mottlab/chickpea/Imputation/Results/Ca1_3_tmp/
K =  8
environment = server
nCores =  1
nGen =  10
method =  haploid

This is the output:

messages.body_plain:
Hey Richard,

What version is this? In any case, isn't chickpea a diploid species? STITCH right now only supports running in diploid (recommended) or pseudoHaploid method. If you want to run proper haploid I can take a look at what needs to be done under the hood to make this possible? Even if the chickpeas are fully inbred you won't lose a huge amount by running in diploid given the coverage is so high. Haploid imputation is obviously theoretically very straightforward, the trick would be finding time to code it back in properly

Robbie
